HUNGAMA DIGITAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED (CIN: U74120MH2011PTC224699) is an unlisted (privately held) 15-year-old Private Company limited by shares incorporated on 08 Dec 2011 and registered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. The company is currently active as per public regulatory records under the jurisdiction of Registrar of Companies (RoC ROC Mumbai, Western Region). It operates primarily in the Advertising & Marketing, Information Technology Services, Tech-Enabled Services sector(s) with the principal business activity of a full-service digital advertising and marketing agency that provides end-to-end solutions in creative communication, social media management, and experiential marketing to help brands enhance their online presence and consumer engagement. HUNGAMA DIGITAL SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED carries an authorized share capital of ₹15 L and a paid-up capital of ₹12.5 L, with no active RoC-registered charges or secured borrowings. Its board of directors comprises 3 active director(s) with verified DIN, contact and KYC information sourced from public regulatory filings.
